question: to the Commission Asger Christensen (Renew) Subject:

The intention of the Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR) – i.e. to harmonise packaging rules across the EU’s internal market – is not always obvious to smaller companies that are facing major challenges in complying with the legislation. Companies are finding that complying with the rules across countries is an extremely complicated business, with different national registration and reporting systems in place, for example, as well as different administrative requirements. Companies selling their wares across the EU can be saddled with major administrative and financial burdens that hamper their business opportunities. 1.

How will the Commission ensure that, in practice, the PPWR creates uniform rules across Member States so that small businesses do not have to devote a disproportionate amount of resources to navigating a plethora of different national systems?

In this context, will the Commission establish a common EU solution whereby companies can report packaging data via a single platform, along the lines of the onestop shop, so that companies selling across the EU do not have to deal with separate national systems and reporting arrangements?
